heraliz_quetes.tuto.varga: Listen carefully. Out here, without a shelter for your gear, you won't last a week. I'll help you build your base. Are you with me?
heraliz_quetes.tuto.intro: Go see Commander Varga to start the tutorial
heraliz_quetes.tuto.kit: Listen to Varga: off to the bases world
heraliz_quetes.tuto.retour: Go back to the bases world to finish your cabin
heraliz_quetes.tuto.etape.1: Take the building plan in hand
heraliz_quetes.tuto.etape.4: Place the 5 walls and the door
heraliz_quetes.tuto.etape.7: Place the Claim Block in the cabin
heraliz_quetes.tuto.etape.8: Put planks in the Claim Block
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.1: Varga here. Let's build you a shelter. Take the building plan: the slot blinking green in your hotbar. And relax: nobody can hurt you until your base is finished.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.2: Good. Aim at a flat spot: the foundation shows up in front of you. Left click to place it, R to turn it. If you have another piece, hold right click: the Foundation blinks in the wheel.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.3: Perfect. The second foundation blinks green, right next to the first one. Aim at it and left click: it's the only spot allowed.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.4: Put the walls up: aim at each blinking green piece and left click. To change piece, hold right click and pick the one blinking in the wheel: Wall, or Doorway for the entrance.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.5: You need a roof. In the wheel (hold right click), pick Floor, then place the 2 green floors on top of the walls.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.6: Right now it's just twigs: it won't hold anything. Take the hammer (it blinks), aim at a piece blinking orange, hold right click and pick Wood. Do it on every orange piece.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.7: Solid. Now the Claim Block: take it from your hotbar and place it on the green spot, at the back of the cabin. This ground becomes yours.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.8: A base decays if nobody maintains it. Right click the Claim Block and put oak planks in it: the counter on the right tells you how many.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.9: One last thing: take the metal crate and place it on the green spot, near the door. Store your gear in it, and always close the door behind you: an open door is an invitation.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.1: Look at your hotbar at the bottom of the screen: the green slot is the plan. Press its number or scroll the mouse wheel to it.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.2: With the plan in hand, look at the ground in front of you, not too far: the foundation shows up. Green means you can place it: left click. Red: move to a flatter spot.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.3: Walk up to your first foundation and look at the green piece blinking next to it. When the piece you aim at sits on it, left click.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.4: Walk up to the edge of a foundation and look at the blinking green piece. If the wheel shows another piece than the blinking one, hold right click and pick the blinking one.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.5: Look at the top of a wall: the green floor shows up above it. If it doesn't, hold right click and pick Floor in the wheel.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.6: Walk up to an orange wall, hammer in hand, and look right at it. Hold right click: a wheel opens. Move to Wood, which blinks, and let go.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.7: The Claim Block is in your hotbar (it blinks). Take it, go inside the cabin and aim at the green square on the floor, at the back: right click to place it.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.8: Aim at the Claim Block and right click: a small screen opens. Drag oak planks from your inventory into the planks slot at the top.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.aide.9: The metal crate is in your hotbar (it blinks). Take it and aim at the green square near the door: right click to place it.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.fin: Nice work. Look at it, your base. It's safe from raids for %s days. After that, anyone can come and loot it: upgrade it to stone then metal, and keep planks in the Claim Block.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.radio.fin2: I'll let you manage on your own. From spawn, /home brings you back here; from your base, /spawn takes you to spawn. When you want missions, come and see me at spawn. Dismissed.
heraliz_quetes.tuto.notif_fin: Tutorial complete: Commander Varga is waiting for you at spawn with missions
